question.worked_solution:
We start by using the power of product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}y\cdot {({x}^{3}y)}^{2}={x}^{2}y\cdot ({x}^{3})^{2}\cdot {y}^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we use the power rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}y\cdot ({x}^{3})^{2}\cdot {y}^{2} & = \\ {x}^{2}y\cdot {x}^{3\cdot 2}\cdot {y}^{2} & = \\ {x}^{2}y\cdot {x}^{6}\cdot {y}^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we use the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}y\cdot {x}^{6}\cdot {y}^{2} & = \\ ({x}^{2}\cdot {x}^{6})\cdot (y\cdot {y}^{2}) & = \\ {x}^{2+6}\cdot {y}^{1+2} & = \\ {x}^{8}\cdot {y}^{3} & = \\ {x}^{8}{y}^{3} & \end{aligned}
$$
